title: Desk bridge v0: theme
description: The person's own themes (ADR 0058). A user theme is a theme plugin in the desk's user themes folder, one folder per theme, installed like any plugin but not built in: theme.save writes one, theme.import installs a .desk-theme bundle (specs/plugin ThemeBundle), theme.export writes any installed theme as one, and theme.remove deletes a user theme; theme.market.list and theme.market.fetch read the markets desk.theme.markets lists (ADR 0060). Every call needs theme:manage; each change reaches plugin:manage holders as plugin.changed. Which theme is in force stays with the setting desk.theme.active.

ThemeSaveFile.description: One of the theme's font or image files, given inline.

ThemeBundleUrl.description: An https URL of a .desk-theme file. Plain http, and a redirect to another host, are refused.

ThemeSha256.description: The sha256 of a file's bytes, lowercase hex.

ThemeSaveRequest.description: Save a theme as the person's own: write its folder in the user themes folder, check it as a theme plugin, then install it. It replaces an earlier user theme of the same id whole; when the check fails nothing is written and the earlier one stays. An id a built-in or any other plugin holds is already_exists.

manifest.description: The theme's plugin.json: kind theme, with an id inside local. (for example local.my-paper).

files.description: Font and image files the theme block names, each path once. With the ones copyFrom brings they are the theme folder's only files besides plugin.json.

copyFrom.description: An installed theme (built-in, market or local) to copy files from: every font and backdrop image the saved theme block names that files does not give and that exists at the same path in that theme's folder. How a tuned copy keeps the fonts and images of the theme it started from. One that is not an installed theme is not_found.

ThemeSaveResult.description: Result of theme.save: the theme as installed.

ThemeImportRequest.description: Install a .desk-theme bundle as a user theme: given inline, read from a file, or downloaded over https and checked against its sha256 (a mismatch is invalid_params and nothing lands). A bundle whose id is outside local. and market. lands as local.<its name as a slug>. It is checked and replaces an earlier user theme of its id as theme.save does, except that a market. theme downloaded by url replaces an earlier one only while that one is still as its market published it (ADR 0060): one the person changed is already_exists and stays.

ThemeImportParams.description: Parameters of theme.import: exactly one of bundle, path and url, and sha256 with url (market only with url).

market.description: With url, the market index that listed it: kept beside a market. theme with its version and sha256, so theme.market.list tells an update from the person's own changes.

ThemeImportResult.description: Result of theme.import: the theme as installed, under the id it landed with.

ThemeExportRequest.description: Make a .desk-theme bundle of any installed theme, built-in ones too: its plugin.json and the font and image files its theme block names. Returned with inline; otherwise written to path, or to <Downloads>/<id>.desk-theme (<id>-2.desk-theme and on when that is taken), and the file's path returned.

ThemeExportParams.description: Parameters of theme.export. inline: true takes no path.

path.description: Where to write the bundle; an existing file there is replaced.

inline.description: Return the bundle instead of writing it.

ThemeExportResult.description: Result of theme.export: the bundle with inline, otherwise the file written.

path.description: The file written, as an absolute path.

ThemeRemoveRequest.description: Remove a user theme: its folder goes and plugin.changed says removed. Only themes in the user themes folder (local. and market. ids); any other plugin is invalid_params, an id nothing holds not_found. A removed theme that desk.theme.active names leaves the desk's own theme in force.

ThemeMarketUrl.description: An https URL of a market index (specs/plugin ThemeIndex, desk-theme-index/1).

ThemeMarketListRequest.description: Read every market index desk.theme.markets lists, in order, and merge their themes by id: the first market that lists an id wins. Each index is downloaded over https from its own host only; one that cannot be read or is not a valid index leaves its themes out and says why in problems. Each theme says whether this desk has it.

ThemeMarketListResult.description: Result of theme.market.list: the merged themes in market order, and the markets that could not be read.

ThemeMarketTheme.description: One theme a market offers: its index entry with url made absolute, the market that listed it, and how it stands on this desk.

installed.description: The version this desk has, when it has the theme.

ThemeMarketState.description: available: not installed. installed: installed as the market publishes it now. update: installed from a market and unchanged since, and the market has other bytes now; installing it again replaces it. edited: installed but not as a market published it (changed since, or brought in from a file); an update never replaces it.

ThemeMarketProblem.description: A market index that could not be read, and why.

ThemeMarketFetchRequest.description: Download a market theme to look at it before installing it: over https from the URL's host only, refused unless its bytes match sha256, and checked as a theme plugin in a temporary folder that goes again. Nothing is installed; the answer is the bundle, which the studio previews.

ThemeMarketFetchResult.description: Result of theme.market.fetch: the checked bundle.
